# Volunteer Waiver & Release Drafting Skill for Muse

Drafts a Volunteer Waiver and Release of Liability Agreement for nonprofits or corporate volunteer programs, balancing maximum liability protection with state-law compliance. It walks through the full build order — header and parties, covered activities and scope, risk disclosures matched to actual activities (physical, outdoor, client-facing, premises), assumption of risk, a conspicuously formatted release of liability (bold/boxed acknowledgment that the volunteer is giving up the right to sue), indemnification, medical authorization with emergency contacts and treatment consent, standard legal provisions (governing law, venue, severability, jury waiver where permissible), and a separate parent/guardian consent section for minor volunteers — plus a pitfalls checklist: no gross-negligence releases, non-waivable claims, multi-state drafting, and annual legal review as case law evolves. Discovered via skills.sh. Honest note: US jurisdiction only (frontmatter: jurisdiction us) — not usable as-is for Canadian or other legal systems; it drafts a legal document, so have a lawyer review it before use — this is not legal advice; the skill frontmatter credits CaseMark as author while the skill is published from the @thomasmoreai repo — the listing here credits the repository source. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use. skills.sh Trust Hub: Pass.
